perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Lilly's existing Q2 2026 evidence showed 48% revenue growth to $23.0 billion, driven primarily by Mounjaro and Zepbound volume, alongside increased full-year revenue guidance.

On 2026-09-18 the FDA granted full approval to Inluriyo (imlunestrant) in combination with Verzenio for adults with ER+, HER2-, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression following endocrine therapy, adding a fresh commercial/regulatory signal outside the incretin franchise.
The approved combination broadens Lilly's oncology execution surface while the company continues late-stage obesity and manufacturing expansion programs.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: The 2026-09-18 FDA approval is realized regulatory execution rather than a prospective pipeline milestone and therefore strengthens evidence of portfolio breadth.
The approval does not establish material revenue contribution, payer uptake, market share, or margin from the combination; those remain post-launch execution tests.
The prior contradiction remains active: exceptional incretin volume/revenue momentum coexists with meaningful realized-price compression, so growth and pricing pressure must both remain visible.

risks: Realized-price declines can offset volume growth and intensify as access broadens.
Retatrutide remains investigational pending regulatory submissions and approvals.
A new oncology approval does not guarantee rapid uptake or material financial contribution.
Large manufacturing commitments and acquisition activity raise execution and capital-allocation demands.
contradictions: Very strong volume/revenue momentum coexists with meaningful realized-price compression; both must be preserved rather than collapsing the signal into a one-direction growth narrative.
unknowns: Long-run net pricing after payer/government changes is uncertain.
Retatrutide approval timing and eventual commercial uptake remain unknown.
Commercial uptake, payer coverage and financial contribution from the newly approved Inluriyo-Verzenio combination are not yet established.
